hero.title: Bitcoin think tank questions MSCI’s ‘invisible committee’ over Strategy, Metaplanet rule
hero.description: A Bitcoin Policy Institute paper says MSCI’s proposed “non-operating company” rule could remove Strategy and Metaplanet from its indexes and may have roots in an earlier crypto treasury review.

latest.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
latest.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

latest.title: South Korean President Lee pushes back on Alaska LNG project after Trump touts Seoul's participation
latest.description: The U.S. announced plans for up to $200 billion in South Korean investment, though Seoul has yet to finalize the participation in the Alaska LNG project.

latest.title: UK Prime Minister Burnham says Iran 'played a part' in British air base incident
latest.description: RAF Fairford has been used as the U.S. Air Force's command outpost for operations from Europe and for American strikes on Iranian missile sites.

latest.title: Dogecoin gets DeFi testnet as DogeOS bets miners will eventually secure its apps
latest.description: DogeOS wants to turn DOGE into more than a payments and speculation asset, but its applications still rely on selected operators rather than Dogecoin miners.

latest.title: Crypto hacks top $768M in September, worst month of 2026
latest.description: The $388 million Bitget breach and $320 million Liquid Network exploit accounted for most of September’s losses, though more than $270 million from the latter was later returned.

latest.title: Bitcoin's soft-inflation pop to $85,500 fades as bond yields refuse to fall
latest.description: A cooler-than-expected PCE report sent bitcoin briefly above $85,000 on Wednesday. Treasury yields held near their highest since 2002 and the gains drained away.

latest.title: In photos: China's Xi hardens Taiwan warning as country celebrates week-long National Day holiday
latest.description: China began its seven-day National Day holiday on Thursday after President Xi Jinping used his annual speech to sharpen Beijing's message on Taiwan.

latest.title: AI race heats up as OpenAI flags alleged model-copying campaign
latest.description: OpenAI says it identified an attempt to extract protected reasoning from its AI models, linking part of the activity with China’s Moonshot AI.

latest.title: Trump’s AI lunch included every major tech company. Except Apple
latest.description: Apple's absence from Trump's AI lunch raised eyebrows, but the company is known to look out for its own interests.

latest.title: Passengers and crew foil co-pilot's apparent attempt to crash FlyDubai flight to Israel
latest.description: One of the pilots on a FlyDubai flight headed for Israel stabbed the second pilot, according to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

latest.title: CFTC seeks to define event contracts as swaps amid prediction market fight
latest.description: The classification could assist the CFTC’s claim that it has exclusive federal jurisdiction over event contracts offered on regulated prediction markets.

latest.title: Inside India newsletter: Foreign insurers get the red-carpet treatment — and policy uncertainty
latest.description: Foreign insurers brace for another set of policy changes in India's insurance market.

latest.title: MetaMask exits Ethereum validators amid undisclosed security incident
latest.description: MetaMask said it is investigating the threat internally and said it has found no immediate threat to its wallets.

latest.title: California Gov. Gavin Newsom bans AI 'robo bosses' in landmark state law, reversing his earlier veto
latest.description: California Governor Gavin Newsom has banned 'robo-bosses' from firing workers, the first U.S. state with such a law.

latest.title: Fed's Kashkari says inflation is 'still too high' even after softer-than-expected PCE data, labor market is 'pretty good'
latest.description: Kashkari sat down with CNBC's Steve Liesman for an exclusive conversation Wednesday night.

latest.title: Gemini 4 Is Here, and Google’s Flagship Tops All Other AI Models on Cybersecurity
latest.description: Gemini 4 Argon tops 12 of 18 benchmarks in Google's own table, writes a million tokens per reply and resists hijacking best. Cyber defenders get it first, with the guardrails off.

latest.title: David Ellison names Ynon Kreiz co-CEO of Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery
latest.description: Paramount CEO David Ellison announced outgoing Mattel chief Ynon Kreiz will serve as the co-CEO of the anticipated combination of Paramount and WBD.

latest.title: Cramer says 'frozen' conditions are holding many stocks back. Here's what could change that
latest.description: CNBC's Jim Cramer said Wednesday that several key parts of the U.S. economy have effectively frozen.

latest.title: Trump 'thinking about' diesel export ban, but says it could have 'negative impact' on gasoline
latest.description: Trump recently said he was "very seriously" considering a diesel export ban, despite warnings from the U.S. oil industry that doing so would raise prices.
